company.name: Panadata
company.shortDescription: Panadata is a data mining firm that primarily focuses on sourcing and optimizing the public information to its diverse clientele.
company.description: Panadata brings together the most important consultation sites in a single platform in an easy and friendly way, even creating search alternatives and management of public information that traditional sites do not offer.
